original_claim: Specs-only predictions outperform baselines on market success forecasting
supporting_evidence: Outperforms Global Mean (rho=0.562 vs 0.000) and Brand-Only (rho=0.472)
contradicting_evidence: Category+Brand Ridge (0.712), GBDT (0.698), Random Forest (0.694), Category Median (0.691), and Spec TF-IDF (0.683) all achieve higher pooled rank correlation
strongest_contradicting_result: Category+Brand Ridge achieves rho=0.712 (paired p=0.0035 vs proposed)
statistical_support: No (statistically inferior to top baselines on pooled rank)
recommended_action: Retract claim of outperforming baselines. Transparently report that metadata and tree baselines achieve higher pooled correlation. Reframe around interpretable semantic screening.

original_claim: Monotonic constraints improve holdout AUC from 0.826 to 0.903 and temporal AUC to 0.942
supporting_evidence: Enforces non-increasing price and non-decreasing quality effects; prevents non-physical sign inversions
contradicting_evidence: On frozen temporal holdout (n=124), unconstrained XGBoost achieves AUC=0.879 vs monotone AUC=0.890; difference is not statistically significant (p=0.753)
strongest_supporting_result: Monotone constraints guarantee correct partial derivatives in SHAP
column14: Retract claim that monotonic constraints improve empirical accuracy. Frame them strictly as domain-grounded inductive bias preventing illogical inversions.

original_claim: XGBoost posted the best R^2 (0.564) and AUC (0.983) across all algorithms
supporting_evidence: XGBoost achieves competitive R^2=0.550 and fast training time (0.29s); native missing value and categorical support
contradicting_evidence: Gradient Boosting achieved higher CV fit (R^2=0.558 vs 0.550) and higher temporal holdout correlation (rho=0.698 vs 0.562)
strongest_supporting_result: XGBoost handles missing aspect features without imputation
strongest_contradicting_result: GBDT CV R^2=0.558 and temporal rho=0.698
recommended_action: Eliminate 0.564 text claim. Unify Table 1 and text: GBDT led in empirical CV fit (0.558 vs 0.550); XGBoost selected for architectural properties (missingness, categorical, SHAP).

original_claim: Price-only baseline correlates at rho = 0.147 across all products, far below model
supporting_evidence: Within-category price percentile alone achieves modest correlation (rho=0.147 historical
strongest_supporting_result: When price is combined with category and brand priors, simple linear models achieve pooled rho=0.712, exceeding the proposed model
strongest_contradicting_result: Model aspects are largely orthogonal to price (r=0.147 with price percentile)
statistical_support: Category + Brand Ridge achieves rho=0.712 without LLM aspects
column13: Acknowledge that while price position alone is insufficient, joint category and brand priors provide strong pooled ranking baselines.

original_claim: Bridging recovers about four-fifths of attainable pooled rank correlation (0.590 vs 0.738)
supporting_evidence: Operational model correlates with oracle predictions at rho=0.628 (p=3.58e-15); captures 74.5% of oracle rank correlation ceiling
contradicting_evidence: Spearman ratio (74.5%) reflects ordinal agreement, not 75% information recovery. Squared correlation ratio is 55.6% (0.316 vs 0.568)
strongest_supporting_result: Ratio of Spearman rank correlations is 0.562 / 0.754 = 74.5%
statistical_support: Yes (as a descriptive ratio of correlations)
recommended_action: Replace 'recovers four-fifths of information' with exact wording: 'operational model achieves a ratio of Spearman rank correlations of 74.5% and a squared correlation ratio of 55.6% relative to the oracle ceiling'.

original_claim: Specifications predict experiential aspects (utility, durability) but cannot predict service or aesthetics
supporting_evidence: Empirical fidelity weights confirm high correlation for utility (r=0.53) and durability (r=0.53); low for after-sales (r=0.07) and design (r=0.21)
contradicting_evidence: None; human validation audit confirms exact same pattern
strongest_supporting_result: Utility r=0.53, build quality r=0.51, after-sales r=0.07
recommended_action: Preserve and highlight as a core scientific contribution: specifications exhibit asymmetric aspect recoverability.

original_claim: Method validity tracks category spec-expressiveness: works in electronics, fails in capacity appliances
supporting_evidence: Smartwatches achieve positive within-category correlation (rho=0.415); ice makers collapse (fidelity r=0.04
strongest_supporting_result: Ice maker reviews correlate strongly with success (mean |r|=0.32), proving failure is in spec bridging, not target validity
strongest_contradicting_result: Smartwatches rho=0.415; ice maker bridging fidelity r=0.04
statistical_support: None; failure diagnosis is mathematically clean
column13: Elevate as central scientific discovery: pre-launch specification modeling is fundamentally bounded by whether technical specs encode experiential attributes.

original_claim: System provides calibrated decision support via reliability weighting, trust tiers, and abstention
supporting_evidence: Interface weights confidence by empirical aspect fidelity; trust badges displayed; abstains when specs lack grounding
contradicting_evidence: None; architectural and functional tests confirm mechanism operates as specified
strongest_supporting_result: Reliability-weighted confidence successfully downweights ungrounded aspects
recommended_action: Preserve as operational framework contribution: demonstrates how an AI system can expose its own measured empirical limitations to users.

original_claim: LLM semantic bridging provides incremental predictive accuracy over non-LLM baselines
supporting_evidence: Model 2 (aspects alone) achieves rho=0.526 without metadata
strongest_supporting_result: Ablation A (removing LLM aspects) increases performance to rho=0.726; Spec TF-IDF achieves rho=0.683; GBDT achieves rho=0.698
strongest_contradicting_result: Aspects alone correlate at rho=0.526 (AUC=0.886) without metadata
statistical_support: Ablating LLM aspects yields Delta rho = +0.164 (p < 0.001)
column13: Retract claim that LLM bridge improves predictive accuracy. Frame bridge as providing structured, interpretable quality dimensions rather than accuracy lift.

original_claim: Model enables cold-start prediction for unknown brands without historical brand records
supporting_evidence: Model achieves rho=0.585 on unseen brands (n=82) where brand-only baseline fails completely (variance=0); smartwatches unseen rho=0.253
contradicting_evidence: Category Mean alone achieves rho=0.686 on the same unseen brands; pooled correlation on unseen brands is driven by between-category shifts
strongest_supporting_result: Smartwatches unseen rho=0.253 vs TF-IDF rho=-0.406
strongest_contradicting_result: Category Mean achieves rho=0.686 on unseen brands (p=1.18e-12)
external_validity: but does not beat category mean pooled)
column13: Nuance claim: LLM aspects support product differentiation within spec-expressive categories under cold start, but pooled unseen correlation is dominated by category priors.
